page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Running text, then a centred heading "ANNOTATIONES.", then a commentary paragraph with a large initial and italic type. Catchword at lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: est, strepitus urbis derelictus est, redastūq; est fortalicium & propugnaculum in spe-luncas usq; in seculum, ubi gaudent onagri & pascuntur greges. Donec effundatur super nos spiritus de excelso,& fiat ex deserto ager cultus, atque ager cultus pro sylua reputetur. Habitabit iudicium in deserto, & iusticia in campo fertili manebit. Et erit opus iusticiæ pax, & opus iusticiæ tranquillitas atque securitas usq; in seculum. Et sedebit populus meus in habitaculo pacis, & in mansionibus securis, atq; in refrigerijs tutissimis. Diuertet enim grando quum descederit,in sylvam: & in ualle hu militer desidebit ciuitas. Beati vos qui seminatis super omnem (locum) aquosum, immittitis pedem bouis & asini,
main_text.head: ANNOTATIONES.
main_text.p: ECce in iusticia rex.) Quemadmodum hactenus egit propheta contra quosdā ex promi-scua multitudine, deinde & contra primores, sparsim quoque de omnium ordinum officijs:ita nunc quoq; agit de officio regis,id autem paucis: quia vide-licet non opus erat regem per se pium, & libenter ex solo Deo pendentem,prolixius commonefacere. Proderat autem hoc pacto de regis officio tractari: ut omnes uidentes optimum regem officium suum optimè præstare,

page.notes: Page number at top right is hard to read; read as "ccc" with doubt. "paucis:" is uncertain (could be "paucu:"). The large initial "E" is joined to "Cce" as "ECce". The word "præstare," is the catchword at lower right. Long s was rendered as plain s throughout, including "est" and "sylua", which the scan prints with ligatures. The "ꝑ" and other abbreviations are kept as printed where legible. The first line of the scan's running text starts mid-sentence and is marked cont="true".
